subject.title: bug: withAllowedHostname only updates allowedHostnames, not hostnameAllowlist — breaks navigate with non-empty hostnameAllowlist

question: Should OpenClaw fix this by passing a distinct scoped CDP control policy into Playwright/session helpers, or by broadening `withAllowedHostname` to satisfy both hostname policy fields?
rationale: Both approaches can unblock the reporter, but they differ in how much they relax a browser SSRF boundary that currently has an explicit test asserting the stricter behavior.

options.title: Use Scoped CDP Control Policy
options.body: Keep page navigation policy unchanged and pass `resolveCdpControlPolicy` or an equivalent scoped policy into CDP connection, target lookup, and Playwright session paths.

options.title: Broaden The Helper
options.body: Update `withAllowedHostname` to add the selected CDP host to both hostname fields, then prove this cannot affect page-navigation checks.

options.title: Keep Strict Operator Burden
options.body: Require users with `hostnameAllowlist` to include the CDP host explicitly and update docs/tests to make that behavior intentional.

recommendation.title: Use Scoped CDP Control Policy
recommendation.body: Keep page navigation policy unchanged and pass `resolveCdpControlPolicy` or an equivalent scoped policy into CDP connection, target lookup, and Playwright session paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the shared helper refactor now at the center of the mismatch and are the clearest routing owner from verified PR/commit history.
